description.value:
Speed +10 feet. A memosprite Skill supporting an ally marks enemies for +1 allied hit damage taken for 2 turns. An enemy-targeting memosprite Skill grants party critical damage bonus +2 for 2 turns. When both effects coexist, increase each bonus by 1.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching remembrance Path required.

source.custom: Honkai: Star Rail / Telys D&D conversion
